question:
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must restrict users assigned to the sangroup role on the Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch from issuing commands on VSANs 15 to 20. Which command must the engineer run to achieve this objective?
Role: sangroup
Description: SAN management group
vsan policy: deny
Permitted vsans: 10-30

Rule  Type    Command-type   Feature
1.    permit  config         *
2.    deny    config         fspf
3.    permit  debug          zone
4.    permit  exec           fcping
theory: The sangroup role's VSAN policy is set to deny by default with an explicit exception list ('Permitted vsans: 10-30') that currently includes the 15-20 range the administrator wants to restrict. Because the permitted range is configured as a specific override rather than the whole policy, removing just that override with no permit vsan 15-20 trims 15-20 back out of the allowed set while leaving the rest of the permitted range (10-14 and 21-30) untouched, precisely targeting the restriction requested. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 20 - User Role Policies, VSAN policy)
